category: Brazilian voucher reseller for host premium (BRFiles, TakeFile and others)

free_tier.stated: None. The store sells vouchers only.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the voucher activates BRFiles premium, so BRFiles' own 8 GB per-file cap applies.

retention.stated: The voucher buys a period of BRFiles premium; the seller prices 30 days up to a year inside 'R$ 29,90 atraves R$ 249,90'. Files then follow BRFiles' own no-expiry rule while premium is active.

egress.terms: No egress terms of its own: the voucher activates the host's premium, which carries 'Baixe ate 2 TB por mes' at BRFiles.

interface_detail: The deliverable is a text voucher code, not an account: 'voce ira receber um Voucher (codigo) com este codigo acessara o site BRFiles.com e criara uma nova conta ou renovara uma conta ja existente'. The code is redeemed in the host's own panel.
tooling: Nothing to install. The buyer redeems the code at brfiles.com/planos/ and keeps using the host's own site and download managers.
chaining: This is the safe way to buy Brazilian host premium from outside: the account stays in the buyer's name and email, so the reseller cannot rotate the password or resell the same session, and the host's 2 TB/month applies to one owner.

limits.value: the host's 2 TB per month, unchanged by the reseller

limits_note: The seller's own constraint is delivery time: 'Prazo Entrega: Alguns minutos, no maximo 12 horas, apos a confirmacao do pagamento'. A voucher bought in a hurry can arrive after the need.
binding_note: The voucher changes nothing about the host's limits; at 1 TiB/month the BRFiles 2 TB allowance holds, at 2 TiB it does not.
price_per_tb_month: BRL 29.90 to BRL 249.90 depending on term (USD 5.93 to USD 49.60 at 5.0383); the exact per-term grid is behind a variant selector that did not render

identity_cost.detail: The buyer's own email, login and password are used at the host: 'O periodo premium e resgatado em seu e-mail, login e senha pessoal, voce pode alterar estes dados sempre que desejar.' That sentence is the difference between this product and a resold credential.

reliability_note: Voucher delivery is manual and can take up to 12 hours. A voucher that fails to redeem is a support ticket, not a lockout, because the account remains the buyer's.
confidence_note: The voucher mechanism, the price range, the delivery window and the buyer-owned-account sentence were read on the product page today. The per-duration price grid did not render, so only the range is given.

evidence.proved: 'Faixa de preco: R$ 29,90 atraves R$ 249,90' and 'Nao e Gerador de Link. Conta Individual, acesso direto ao BRFiles, sem espera'

notes: Mundo Premium is the counter-example that makes main distinction usable. Same product category as the R$ 24.90 Real-Debrid listings - a cheap way to hold premium - but delivered as a voucher into an account the buyer controls. It also sells TakeFile at R$ 289.90 to R$ 1,069.90, so the catalogue covers hosts the multi-hosts do not.
